name: Meeting assistant
description: Live feedback from an agent during a meeting.
changelog: Start begins the Superwhisper meeting recording for you (and ends it and puts your mode back after), and the chat opens in your browser as soon as anyone speaks.
notice: Start begins a Superwhisper meeting recording if one isn't already running. What's said in this meeting leaves your Mac. Tell the people in it.

reads: the transcript and speaker names of the Superwhisper meeting that started in the last 15 minutes, or of the one it starts
which Superwhisper mode you have selected, so it can put it back
sends: transcript text to the canopy session it opens, and so to the agent's model provider
the whole transcript to your private Meetings page in Canopy, when a meeting ends by itself

brief.label: What kind of feedback do you want?

from_start.label: Include what was said before you pressed Start

open_chat.label: Open the chat in my browser when people start talking

checks.label: Superwhisper's command-line tool is set up
checks.fix: Install Superwhisper's command-line tool so that ~/.local/bin/superwhisper exists, then try again.

checks.label: Superwhisper is open
checks.fix: Open Superwhisper, then press Start again.
